name: Antigua
peoples: Earlier Indigenous societies, including Arawakan-speaking communities
summary: English settlement, a French wartime interlude, then independence.
notes: Antigua and Barbuda have separate tracks because the French invasions of Antigua do not establish a French transfer of Barbuda.

events.title: Spain claims Antigua
events.detail: Columbus named the island without founding a Spanish colony.
events.qualification: A European claim; it does not establish island-wide administration or extinguish Indigenous rights.

events.title: An English colony
events.detail: Settlers from Saint Kitts established the colony.

events.title: French forces invade
events.detail: The Second Anglo-Dutch War reached Antigua.

events.title: A second French occupation
events.detail: French forces returned later in the month.

events.title: English authority restored
events.detail: French occupation ended; the Treaty of Breda confirmed restitution.
